findings.text: 01.AI describes Responsible AI Safety Engine (RAISE), a four-part safety engine covering pre-training filtration, post-training safety rewards, and inference-time input/output controls, but reports no safety benchmark scores.

findings.text: Pre-training filtration uses Transformer and deep neural network (DNN) classifiers to reduce biased content and block personally identifiable information (PII) leakage in the corpus.

notes: Technical report (arXiv 2412.01253), not a system card. Section 6 describes RAISE qualitatively only: no numerical safety, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, or dangerous-capability scores. Topics left uncovered: RAISE filters and RLHF safety rewards are training/serving methods, not topic tests or model-behavior claims per pilot. October 16, 2024 is Chatbot Arena first appearance, not treated as releaseDate. yi-lightning-lite appears only in an Arena leaderboard snapshot, not as a model this report develops.
